## `write_memory` — Write Memory

GATED: needs server opt-in write_memory. Write bytes or one typed value to target memory (code pages use a code-safe patch). Records a reversible effect holding the original bytes and reads back to verify. Taints later observations of this process. Revert with stop_instrumentation(effect id) or close_session (attached); owned targets are killed at close.

| Phase | Hints       | Effects                            | Gate                    | CLI                                                                                                          |
| ----- | ----------- | ---------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| P3    | destructive | writesTargetMemory, mutatesSession | `write_memory` (always) | scenario: Session state cannot cross CLI processes; use it from MCP or as a step of `bea run scenario.json`. |

| Input field        | Type                                                                    | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id`       | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | yes      | —       | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `address`          | string ≤600                                                             | yes      | —       | 0xVA \| module+0xRVA \| +0xRVA (main) \| module!export[+0xN] \| module!#ordinal \| module:0xSTATIC_VA[/0xSTATIC_BASE] \| $main:0xSTATIC_VA; quote names with + or spaces; module@0xBASE picks one of two same-named modules |
| `hex`              | string ≤8192 `^(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{2})+$`                                    | no       | —       | Bytes to write as even-length hex without spaces, e.g. 0000803f.                                                                                                                                                            |
| `type`             | "i8" \| "u8" \| "i16" \| "u16" \| "i32" \| "u32" \| "i64" \| "u64" \| … | no       | —       | Typed write (with value); bool is one byte.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `value`            | number \| string ≤300 \| boolean                                        | no       | —       | Number, decimal string, "0x…" raw bits of the type, NaN/Infinity/-Infinity; ptr takes an address.                                                                                                                           |
| `sensitive_values` | array<string ≤1024> ≤64                                                 | no       | —       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

Deadline 30,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence always as `bea.memory.write` · sessions live · results carry untrusted target content.

## `override_function` — Override Function

GATED: needs server opt-in override_function. For a bounded lifetime change a function's behavior: rewrite chosen args before it runs, replace its return after it runs, or skip it and return a constant. Every affected call is logged to a recording. A reversible effect, reverted by stop_instrumentation, expiry or close_session. Taints observations of this process.

| Phase | Hints       | Effects                                               | Gate                         | CLI                                                                                                          |
| ----- | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| P3    | destructive | writesTargetMemory, instrumentsTarget, mutatesSession | `override_function` (always) | scenario: Session state cannot cross CLI processes; use it from MCP or as a step of `bea run scenario.json`. |

| Input field    | Type                                                                     | Required | Default  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id`   | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`  | yes      | —        | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `address`      | string ≤600                                                              | yes      | —        | 0xVA \| module+0xRVA \| +0xRVA (main) \| module!export[+0xN] \| module!#ordinal \| module:0xSTATIC_VA[/0xSTATIC_BASE] \| $main:0xSTATIC_VA; quote names with + or spaces; module@0xBASE picks one of two same-named modules |
| `mode`         | "args" \| "return" \| "replace"                                          | yes      | —        | args: rewrite args before the original runs; return: replace its return; replace: skip it.                                                                                                                                  |
| `set_args`     | array<object> ≤8                                                         | no       | `[]`     | Args to rewrite (mode args). Example: [{"arg":1,"type":"f32","value":0}]                                                                                                                                                    |
| `returns`      | "void" \| "i8" \| "u8" \| "i16" \| "u16" \| "i32" \| "u32" \| "i64" \| … | no       | `"void"` |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `return_value` | number \| string ≤300 \| boolean                                         | no       | —        | Value returned (modes return and replace).                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `duration_ms`  | integer 1..3600000                                                       | no       | `10000`  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `max_events`   | integer 1..10000000                                                      | no       | `100000` |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `record`       | boolean                                                                  | no       | `true`   | Log every applied call to the recording (override/1 rows).                                                                                                                                                                  |

## `run_script` — Run Script

GATED: needs server opt-in run_script. Escape hatch: load caller-written Frida JavaScript (QJS or V8) into the target for at most duration_ms, capture its bounded send() messages and errors, optionally call one rpc export, then always unload it. Shares the agent's single JS thread. Runs arbitrary code in the target; prefer the structured tools.

| Phase | Hints       | Effects                                                                                | Gate                  | CLI                                     |
| ----- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| P3    | destructive | writesTargetMemory, injectsCode, instrumentsTarget, executesTargetCode, mutatesSession | `run_script` (always) | `bea script <source>` (session-oneshot) |

| Input field    | Type                                                                    | Required | Default | Description                                                |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id`   | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | yes      | —       | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open. |
| `source`       | string ≤262144                                                          | yes      | —       | Frida JavaScript source.                                   |
| `runtime`      | "qjs" \| "v8"                                                           | no       | `"qjs"` |                                                            |
| `duration_ms`  | integer 0..60000                                                        | no       | `1000`  |                                                            |
| `max_messages` | integer 1..10000                                                        | no       | `1000`  |                                                            |
| `rpc_method`   | string `^[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]{0,63}$`                                | no       | —       | rpc.exports method to call once after load.                |
| `rpc_args`     | array<any> ≤32                                                          | no       | `[]`    |                                                            |

Deadline 90,000 ms · input ≤ 2,097,152 bytes · evidence always as `bea.script.run` · sessions live · results carry untrusted target content.
